kaf-hachayim.1#א: (1) [seif 1] One suspected of eating forbidden things. A great principle: all laws of suspected persons in this siman do not require testimony before court that the man transgressed — then he would be disqualified for testimony too; even rumor suffices — an incessant rumor makes him suspected. Arukh HaShulchan s.k. 20; similarly Chakrei Lev part 1 Yoreh Deah (167): clear testimony not required — even estimation or rumor suffices. Most common people tithe yet were suspected on tithes because the minority causes suspicion — same in other matters — Rashba (64, 400), Ribash (213), Maharik (root 33), Rashdam (41), other Acharonim; see Chakrei Lev (193); Chayei Adam (1); see responsa Maaseh Ish (13); Zivchei Tzedek below s.k. 116; responsa Parashat Mordechai (7); Devarim Chaim Minsanz (4); Ramatz (12–13); Levushei Mordechai (8). However where enemies spread rumor he is not suspected — Arukh HaShulchan; Maharash Engel (17).
kaf-hachayim.1#ב: (1) I saw in Yad Yitzchak part 1 (5) that one is not called suspected unless an incessant rumor that he did this prohibition many times and he is unrestrained; similarly Pnei Yehoshua part 1 (16). I disagree: any suspicion he did prohibition even once — not believed; Shach below (18): suspected on prohibition not believed on it but believed on others'; habitual sinner not believed even on others'; Kenesset HaGedolah; Beli; Chokhmat Adam; Zivchei Tzedek.
kaf-hachayim.1#ג: (1) Even though generally a person does not make himself wicked — if he spread rumor on himself that he transgressed or sold prohibition to others he is suspected; Choshen Mishpat 34:25, 92:5 — not made witness ab initio; likewise for prohibition reliability — not one witness on prohibitions l'chatchila; Hashiv Moshe (22); Ramatz (13); She'el uMeshiv Kama (51); see Haflaah Ketubot 72 on Raavad brought in Rashba and Ran; Noda BiYehudah Even HaEzer 256 — "do not place wicked as witness" only when liable lashes; misleading others not disqualified for testimony — still suspected; see Ramatz (4).
kaf-hachayim.2#_: (2) One may not rely on him regarding them — meaning not to buy from him; but believed to permit others' property as Mechaber below seif 7 (see there s.k.): Taz s.k. 1; Shach s.k. 2; Peri Chadash s.k. 2; Shulchan Gavoah s.k. 3; Zivchei Tzedek s.k. 1.
kaf-hachayim.3#א: (3) If one dined with him he may not eat from matters he is suspected about — suspected on forbidden foods forbidden to eat with him even permitted foods lest he feed forbidden; Shabbat 11; 13; Ri'az in Shulchan Shel Rama first chapter Shabbat; Taz end s.k. 4 in Darkei Moshe from Hagahot Asheri; Kenesset HaGedolah; Beli; Maharalnach (121); Niddah 20; Rosh and Ran there.
kaf-hachayim.3#ב: (3) Peri Chadash end s.k. 6: Darkei Moshe from Hagahot Asheri not from core law — mere stringency and custom of pious; Lechem HaPanim s.k. 6; Shvilei David s.k. 1; question why not cite Shabbat Gemara — perhaps decree only for suspected on tithes common then; not for individual suspected; Bekor Shor on Avodah Zarah 39 — challenged Peri Chadash; Rambam 11:10 — if not careful forbidden to lodge; Mesgeret HaShulchan; Arukh HaShulchan; Eshkol HaShulchan on Rashi Avodah Zarah 38; Gra Bnei Brak Bet David 2; Maharsha responsa (7) — practical leniency; Zivchei Tzedek s.k. 5.
kaf-hachayim.4#_: (4) Rama: even from one not suspected but unrecognized — dispute Rambam/Raavad; Mechaber like Raavad — presume everyone even d'oraisa; Rashi Avodah Zarah 39; Meiri; Ritva; most Acharonim; Maharam Rotenburg (366); Beit She'arim (287); Rashba; Ritva Gittin 2; practice lenient on plain person; Rama in Darkei Moshe custom like Raavad; Shach s.k. 1; Ribash (121); Kenesset HaGedolah; Beli; Makom Shmuel; Knesset Yisrael; Kaf HaChayim Orach Chaim 20:2; Peri Toar leans stringent like Rambam — we follow Acharonim; see s.k. 6.
kaf-hachayim.5#_: (5) However for buying meat — not from every butcher who slaughters for himself and sells unless presumption of kosher — Mechaber siman 65; Shach s.k. 1 — many slaughter laws, easy to disqualify; Peri Chadash s.k. 1; Shulchan Gavoah s.k. 6; Peri Toar questions Shach — still stringent; Ramatz (12); Makom Shmuel no distinction meat vs other — stringent; Shach: slaughterer for others has presumption — only self-slaughterer needs presumption; Sefatei Daat 1:1; Arukh HaShulchan s.k. 8; Shvilei David s.k. 1; Maharam Schick (12); Chatam Sofer (19); Amudim Or (42); Nehar Efrayim (49).
kaf-hachayim.6#_: (6) Nevertheless l'chatchila though we are lenient buying from plain person — fear Rambam in this generation corruption; Taz s.k. 2; Beit Hillel siman 65 — registry requiring rabbinical certificate even for presumed kosher; lost certificate still rely if presumed; Beli; Lechem HaPanim s.k. 2; Kerem Shlomo; especially now; Arukh HaShulchan s.k. 9; Kenesset HaGedolah letter 8 from Rashdam 90 — if reason to fear without presumption, stringent; Beli; Mesgeret HaShulchan; Zivchei Tzedek s.k. 3; Chokhmat Adam 91:1 — buy meat wine milk bread only from recognized presumption lest "before the blind"; responsa Efrakasta DeAnya (70); Ramatz (12); Bekor Shor Avodah Zarah 39; Nahara Mitzrayim.
kaf-hachayim.7#_: (7) If one dined with him he may eat with him — not that l'chatchila forbidden to lodge to eat; even suspected for selling may dine seif 2; Mechaber "if one dined" teaches even b'dieved forbidden to eat from his suspected matters; Rama same b'dieved wording; Shach s.k. 4; Kenesset HaGedolah; Peri Chadash s.k. 4; Beli s.k. 3; Lechem HaPanim s.k. 4.
kaf-hachayim.8#_: (8) Suspected eater with God-fearing wife supervising kitchen — may lodge and eat if she prevents forbidden mixture; Avodah Zarah 39 — daughter of scholar or wife of scholar married to gentile presumed kosher until suspected; Rambam 10:3; Olat Yitzchak (184); Maharach Ruach Chaim s.k. 1 — saw scrupulous eat with suspected hosts because host not suspected to feed especially with careful wife; but without that cannot rely host not feeding — R' Yochanan Demai 2: on himself not believed how on others; Raah Bedek HaBayit believed more careful with others' — Rashba Meshoreret HaBayit rejected; Tashbetz 3:83; Tashbetz 1:63 prefers Rashi/Rashba forbid; Kehal Yehudah 1; Eshkol HaShulchan s.k. 3; Choshen Mishpat 34:47 — stringent; see s.k. 11.
kaf-hachayim.9#_: (9) [seif 2] Not suspected to eat but suspected to sell — may dine; plain suspected seller not suspected eater; suspected eater also suspected seller; Taz s.k. 3; Shach s.k. 5; Peri Chadash s.k. 5; Peri Toar s.k. 5; Lechem HaPanim s.k. 5; Mesgeret HaShulchan; Zivchei Tzedek s.k. 6; Maharsham 6:83; Daat Torah 2:25; Chakrei Lev 150.
kaf-hachayim.10#_: (10) May eat with him but forbidden to buy — even if gives to suspected to taste and suspected eats — forbidden to buy; suspected considers entire sale chain; buyer may tell taste; Peri Toar s.k. 2; Zivchei Tzedek s.k. 7; Yehuda Yaaleh Asad 51; Nehar Efrayim Even HaEzer 53 — kutim believed by law, only clarification; if found eating himself may buy; Peri Toar; Zivchei Tzedek.
kaf-hachayim.11#_: (11) Sending to his house permitted — Raah Bedek HaBayit permits even suspected eater; we do not hold so — Rashba Meshoreret HaBayit; Meiri; Tashbetz 3:83; Peri Chadash s.k. 6; Shulchan Gavoah s.k. 9; Mesgeret HaShulchan; Eshkol HaShulchan s.k. 3; perhaps if clarified he is not suspected to feed — Tashbetz 1:63; requires study; Raah forbade buying only permitted gift.
kaf-hachayim.12#_: (12) Rama: transgressing for appetite not called suspected — not suspected for that matter until transgresses not for appetite; here no concern he will now transgress for appetite; that time was for appetite; Shach s.k. 6; Peri Chadash s.k. 6 — known permitted/forbidden before him; not abandoning permitted; else forbidden; answers Taz s.k. 4; Nakahat HaKesef; Lechem HaPanim agrees Taz concedes; Shulchan Gavoah s.k. 9; Mesgeret HaShulchan; Makom Shmuel; Bet David Bistritz; Chokhmat Adam 91:4; Zivchei Tzedek s.k. 8; Arukh HaShulchan s.k. 13 wrong — follow Acharonim; Binyan Tziyon 10 supports Shach from Sanhedrin 9; Chakrei Lev appetite vs suspected; Beit Hillel siman 2 — nowadays suspected nevelah for appetite do not eat anything with prohibition concern; Kaf HaChayim siman 2 s.k. 24; see s.k. 46.
kaf-hachayim.13#_: (13) [seif 3] Permitted to give own food to suspected eater to prepare/cook — only in his vessels; forbidden in suspected's vessels; Peri Chadash s.k. 9; Kehal Yehudah; Zivchei Tzedek s.k. 9.
kaf-hachayim.14#_: (14) Not concerned he will substitute — Rama siman 118:1 deposit with suspected d'oraisa two seals d'rabbanan one — there suspected to substitute; abbreviated; or suspected on matters public not lenient siman 118:8 and here; Bach; Shach s.k. 7; see siman 118 s.k. 83.
kaf-hachayim.15#_: (15) Since not suspected of theft — suspected to sell still not suspected to steal/substitute by hand; sale instructs heter; Shach s.k. 8; Arukh HaShulchan s.k. 15; Zivchei Tzedek s.k. 10.
kaf-hachayim.16#_: (16) Mother-in-law suspected — Rambam 1:12 not suspected to substitute per Yerushalmi Demai ch.3 — halachah like Sages; Kesef Mishneh; Meiri Chullin 6 — women careful, presumption no spoiled dish; Mahari Kurkus; dissenters say like innkeeper — follow Rambam; Beit Hillel s.k. 1 wonders Mechaber against Rambam; Peri Toar explains Rambam — not feed forbidden to daughter; no clear ruling against Mechaber — lean lenient when doubt; Peri Chadash defends Mechaber — Rashba, Tur; Chatam Sofer 6:11; Mesgeret HaShulchan; practice Mechaber; Eshkol HaShulchan s.k. 16–17.
kaf-hachayim.17#_: (17) Ashamed before son-in-law wants daughter's benefit — also betrothed mother-in-law; Yerushalmi Demai ch.3; Eshkol HaShulchan s.k. 4; Zivchei Tzedek s.k. 11; relative or friend wanting his benefit — Rashba in Tur; Shulchan Gavoah s.k. 13.
kaf-hachayim.18#_: (18) Innkeeper — if known not ashamed of guest as modern innkeepers who care nothing for guest's food — permitted per Rashi Chullin 6; Rashba, Meiri; Rashbetz 1:144; practice Rashi; if pays wages perhaps not suspected — Shach s.k. 9; Peri Chadash; practice Rashi when not ashamed; if ashamed even with wages — forbidden; Zivchei Tzedek s.k. 12.
kaf-hachayim.19#_: (19) [seif 4] Suspected for one matter not for others — all above regarding suspected eater; suspected seller who violates "before the blind" even less severe prohibition or different type — suspected on severe "before the blind" — Netah Shorek 44; Efrakasta DeAnya 70; I disagree — if other prohibition more severe in his eyes not suspected misleading others; poskim seif 7; Arukh HaShulchan s.k. 22; Chakrei Lev 150, 162 stringent; Zivchei Tzedek s.k. 94; lean stringent; see s.k. 118.
kaf-hachayim.20#_: (20) [seif 4] Everything needed for that matter also suspected — suspected selling milk entices with nuts penalized not to sell even nuts; all needed for that sale suspected; suspected seller on severe forbidden in eyes also on light in same food category; if different categories not; suspected for two matters who repented then suspected on one — suspected on both even if lighter; Chakrei Lev 150.
